text:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt failed: user maria tried to push release-2026.03.20-hotfix to prod but lacks 'release.press' role. Error: 403 MFA_REQUIRED. Command: /deploy prod release-2026.03.20-hotfix --force

maria: that's me — I started a rollback for a bad embed model; need to press to finish rollback. Is there a short JIT path?

sam: @maria we normally require MFA + an on-call approval. Who's oncall today?

kai: oncall is @sam today. You need devs with the 'press' scope + a fresh MFA assertion. Jen can approve exceptions but it's not routine.

jen: security here — we can do a timeboxed exception (10m) if you provide the rollout plan and a quick risk checklist. Paste release notes and reason.

maria: reason: embed regression causing incorrect reranks. Plan: 1) pin version, 2) trigger rollback via deploy-bot, 3) monitor logs/metrics for 10m -> confirm. Rollback script: `./scripts/rollback.sh release-2026.03.19-stable`

sam: can you confirm you ran `./infra/verify_canary.sh --tag release-2026.03.19-stable`? Need a green canary before we allow a press.

maria: canary checks done, here's output:
```
canary: 42/42 checks passed
latency_p95: 180ms -> ok
accuracy_eval: reverted to baseline
```

jen: ok. @sam I'll grant a scoped JIT token for 15m to maria, will require MFA and audit log. Reply 'ack' to accept.

maria: ack. Thanks. I'll coordinate and not hot-swap more than one service.

deploy-bot: JIT token issued to maria for 900s. Audit link: https://console.redwood/audit/tx/0x9fabc123 Please confirm when you press.

sam: I'm online; stay on thread, I'll watch rollback and escalate if anything. Tag the release in the changelog.

maria: pressing now: `deploy-bot: /deploy prod rollback release-2026.03.19-stable --pin-version`

deploy-bot: Received deploy command from maria. Auth: JIT token OK. Starting rollback. Rolling back service: embeddings-api -> release-2026.03.19-stable. Estimated downtime <30s.

maria: logs show success. Monitoring metrics.

kai: operational note: remember to rotate the temporary JIT token after use; revoke if not used. I'll revoke after confirmation.

jen: confirmed in audit. Revoke scheduled at 2026-03-20T14:10Z.

maria: rollback complete. I ran smoke tests, looks good. I'll update release notes with root cause: model conversion mismatch on quant step.

sam: thanks. Filing an action item: create playbook step to make pin & rollback the default for high-risk model changes. I'll add in the release retro.

maria: thanks everyone :heart:
